location_exception_reason: Swimming pool sheds are custom-fabricated structures sold nationally across India; location of manufacture or installation is not a buyer decision factor. GI-tagged or regional-origin exemptions do not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Swimming Pool Shed Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title.
